reviews.title: Be careful with the annual subscription!
reviews.text:
Be very careful before starting the free trial! The app only offers an annual subscription, with no monthly option. I forgot to cancel my trial, but canceled immediately on the same day I was charged and requested a refund through Apple. Apple denied my request, and even after contacting support, they refused to offer any solution, not even a partial refund for the unused months.

Now I’m stuck paying for an entire year of an app I don’t want to use. I’m sharing my experience so other people don’t end up in the same situation. Very frustrating and disappointing!

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for I think, almost 500 days. I didn’t originally plan to use it that much, I was just using it to track when I took a new medication and to see if I felt anything from it. And slowly I added more and more to it. More moods, how tired I am, how much pain I’m in, pretty much everything. And everything is so customizable to the point you can essentially use it for anything. This app literally changed my life, I have a very long record of how I’ve been doing, what I’ve been up it, and it made me MUCH more organized as a person. And it’s also extremely easy to use which is helpful. I use this app for everything now, and I’m glad I found it.

reviews.title: Great but…
reviews.text:
This app plus PolarUs is really helpful in monitoring my bipolar II disorder. 

I would give it five stars, but unfortunately the detail oriented part of my brain is really upset by the weird line breaks between single words. I would rather the word shrink to fit the space, or at least be hyphenated where it actually makes sense to hyphenate. When the word “overwhelmed” turns into “overwhel”/med” it just really… gets my goat. Especially when I’m already overwhelmed lol. 

For all the attention put in to making the app look pretty, this is really one simple oversight that has me seriously considering transitioning to another app.

reviews.title: 10 years strong
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for about 10 years now. It has been incredible. It’s not perfect, but I’ve greatly enjoyed it. It gives you the ability to record as much or as little of your day as you’d like. Some days I just list my mood and a few activities. Some days I write my thoughts, attach a bunch of photos, and then leave myself a voice memo like I’m the main character in an Andy Weir sci-fi novel. It “gamifies” journaling in a way that maybe isn’t the most effective for quality journaling, but has kept my streak going for more than 3,000 days. I definitely recommend it.

My only gripe was that I bought the “lifetime” premium membership when I had an android and then had to switch to an iPhone for work and had to re-buy it on Apple. Annoying that it didn’t transfer over. And in that time the price had increased significantly. The free version is honestly fine but there were a few features that after so many years I feel like I wanted to finally lock in.
